mentions.name: daily.dev for Startups
mentions.description: daily.dev for Startups is a product distribution and awareness offering that helps early-stage companies with low budgets get in front of developers at scale to increase awareness of their product.
mentions.problem: Distributing a product and finding developers at scale is hard, especially for early-stage companies with low budgets.
mentions.audience: Early stage companies on low budgets that want to get their product in front of developers
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I've been busy creating a solution for early stage companies who are low and budget but still want get in front of developers and increase awareness to their product. Hopefully it can help others.
